title: Cornwall, 1705: The Drowned Mine

player.status: A stranger of modest means, lately arrived. No trade, no guild, no local standing.
skills: Whatever you actually know from the 21st century, and only that
No practised period craft: your hands are a modern person's

threads: Wheal Fortune's adventurers offer £250 for any means that holds the water below 30 fathoms for a month, and £60 a year while it keeps working.
You carry a letter of introduction to Nicholas Penrose, purser of Wheal Fortune.
Jacca Pascoe's wages, 9s, are due each Saturday.
Smithy rent is paid to Midsummer (24 June); the next quarter is £1 10s.
